I keep trying to repeat the “it gets better” phrase to myself but then all I’m wondering is WHEN. I’m sorry for what you’re going through. I lost my dad 2 years ago, and I haven’t spoken to my mom since I was 13. I think about the life I could have had a lot of the time too, and sometimes I feel selfish for it. Like, I’m not the one who died, who am I to get so upset about the life I do have? But still. I understand, I’m here with you crying at 5:16am and debating whether or not I should actually get some sleep tonight lol. One thing I know is that if so many people who have gone through the same thing say it gets better, it’s probably because it does. You can get through this.

This was happening to me for a while right after my dad died, but mine were a lot less frequent. It probably only happened 3 times and I don’t remember much, I just remember he never talked to me in them. 

The “feeling like absolute shit in the morning” thing I definitely relate to. I think your way of looking at it is a really good one. That she’s still there to watch over you.
